remarks: Extraordinary quality. Impeccable selections. Timeless luxury. Nestled amid expansive and professionally landscaped grounds, this distinguished full-brick residence offers 4 bedrooms, 2.5 baths & a partially finished basement. Exceptional craftsmanship defines its stately exterior & richly appointed interiors. The exquisite Downsview kitchen, renovated in 2024 with cabinetry from Toronto, showcases lustrous marble counters, Kohler fixtures, a kettle faucet & a fabulous walk-in pantry. A Thermador 48-inch six-burner range with grill & XO 48-inch hood join a Dacor refrigerator/freezer, KitchenAid oven & microwave & Bosch dishwasher. From intimate dinners to grand celebrations, this is a kitchen worthy of the occasion. Elegant formal living & dining rooms set the stage for gracious entertaining, while the family room's wood-burning fireplace invites relaxed evenings. A huge first-floor office with French doors & built-ins offers a functional workspace. Rich hardwood floors, refinished in 2018, lend warmth & sophistication throughout. The luxurious primary suite features an oversized bedroom with exquisite inlay hardwood floors, a walk-in closet & an impressive private bath with an oversized walk-in shower & marble vanity. Additional bedrooms offer abundant closet space. The partially finished basement, with new carpeting in 2024, offers possibilities for a media lounge, fitness studio or recreation space with a separate storage room with shelving. Outdoors, unwind in the heated inground spa or dine beneath the Kohler awning veranda with screen enclosure (2019). Irrigation & a Pet Stop invisible fence enhance the picturesque grounds. An oversized 4-car garage includes one heated bay. Investments include the kitchen & double-garage addition (2009), roof (2016), central vacuum (2018), Lennox EL297E high-efficiency two-stage furnace, Super V filtration & Aprilaire humidifier (all 2024). Lennox central air & Amherst Alarm security add to the amenities. Williamsville Central School District & easy access to I-990 & I-290. An in-person experience reveals the exceptional craftsmanship, exquisite finishes & thoughtful details that make this residence truly extraordinary.
